scope: Exactly nine newer Cloud commits; not a full historical-migration or release sign-off.
head: 8f210351afd24b2a472c8a0947f4fae6ea1fe445

features.notes: New coordinated launcher/setup; retired algorithm and historical migration utilities removed. Six meaningful OSS lifecycle entry points retained.
Public tracer_session API, Host caller migration and no-op defaults.
Orphan-datasource handling, priority round-trip, canonical datasource fields and legacy response alias.
Locked Host sync, frontend integrity checks, configurable service selection and isolated setup tests.
Numeric tracing scores wired through Host middleware.
Permission-aware UI bridge, draft lifecycle, unified routes and authenticated OSS gateway; production bundler interoperability repaired.
Job-owned attachments, reuse/new_each_run policy, per-identity storage and UI. Local deployments do not require channel administration.
Chat/task/session queries and Langfuse/HoloScope REST backends. HoloScope querying does not require a Hologres database driver.

checks.name: Host / tracing / gateway
checks.scope: Real SQLite + mocked external integrations; includes UI answers, cron policies, tracing queries and gateway boundaries.

checks.name: Context / semantic / profiling
checks.scope: SQLite and in-memory graph; live graph/provider variants skipped.

checks.name: Startup / account setup
checks.scope: Isolated processes and real Auth/SQLite APIs; model/data services substituted.

checks.name: Auth / attachment safety
checks.scope: Public authentication suite plus cron symlink and duplicate-upload regressions; overlaps Host selection.

checks.name: Local lifecycle / CLI compatibility
checks.scope: Public lifecycle contracts; optional live cases skipped.

checks.name: Release artifact checker
checks.scope: Synthetic malformed/valid distributions validate release gates; not a full seven-wheel installation.

artifacts: Context embedded build and 73-module binding/require audit
limitations: No live model request or Hologres/BigQuery acceptance run.

Browser uses disposable real Host/SQLite, with Context backend intentionally disconnected: rendering, local drafts, route loading and error handling only; no persisted semantic edit or model-driven UI loop.
Large frontend bundle warnings remain; missing-backend Context loaders log an API rejection.
Broader baseline audit/release blockers are not closed by this nine-commit port, including legacy Host suite drift and silent Neo4j read timeout coverage.
No commit or push; existing staged snapshot preserved.
